services.desc: Also on display is a collection of 18th century artifacts found in Highland by Bryan Obaugh During the late 18th and early 19th century, sometimes there wasn’t a choice in the occupation you chose. Sometimes the NECESSITY chose for you. The blacksmith, carpenter and sawyer were generational occupations that the children continued. Come see the early industry and the people that made Highland. You’ll find that we even had quite a few distillers in the county. Learn how a Civil War Battle fought in Highland County impacted Stonewall Jackson's Valley Campaign in 1862.
